value.text:
The user wants me to act as Evidence Critic and check each claim against the cited evidence. I need to flag only factual problems: overstatements, wrong numbers/dates/suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence. Reasonable conclusions from cited facts are supported.

Let me examine each claim:

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-3613-01 is on the FDA shortage list as "Available"; no manufacturer reason or next delivery is specified." Cited: [shortage-0409-3613-01]

Evidence says: "FDA shortage list: Bupivacaine Hydrochloride, Injection, Bupivacaine Spinal 15 mg/2 mL (7.5 mg/mL in 8.25% dextrose) (NDC 0409-3613-01) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Available"; updated 10/21/2026"

The evidence shows availability "Available" and updated date. It doesn't mention manufacturer reason or next delivery. The claim says "no manufacturer reason or next delivery is specified" - this matches the evidence since those fields aren't mentioned. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 159 units provides 15.8 days of cover at 10 units per day; open order of 189 units expected 2026-10-22." Cited: [stock-3]

Evidence says: "bupivacaine BUPIVACAINE HYDROCHLORIDE 7.5 mg/mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-3613-01, ANDA071810): 159 units on hand, 10/day over 30 days, 15.8 days of cover; open orders: PO-SAMPLE-003 open 189 units from AmerisourceBergen, expected 2026-10-22"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-3]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 0409-3613-01 and product 0409-3613: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.
